//go:build integration
// +build integration

package integration

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	internalapi "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

func TestLearningActionContextReadEnforcesStudentOwnership(t *testing.T) {
	pool := getTestDBPool(t)
	defer pool.Close()
	ctx := context.Background()
	studentID := uuid.NewString()
	defer cleanupMasteryStudent(t, pool, studentID)

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	answer := domain.StudentTaskAnswer{
		ID:        uuid.NewString(),
		StudentID: studentID,
		TaskID:    uuid.NewString(),
		StartedAt: now,
		Status:    domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress,
		CreatedAt: now,
		UpdatedAt: now,
	}
	action, err := domain.NewStudentLearningAction(domain.StudentLearningAction{
		ID:                  uuid.NewString(),
		StudentTaskAnswerID: answer.ID,
		StudentID:           studentID,
		TaskID:              answer.TaskID,
		ContextType:         domain.LearningContextLessonTask,
		ContextID:           answer.TaskID,
		LearningTargets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{
			{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.errors", Version: "v1"},
		},
		EvidenceClass: domain.LearningEvidenceApplication,
		OpenedAt:      now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create learning action: %v", err)
	}
	repository := &postgres.LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	_, action, err = repository.CreateAnswer(ctx, answer, nil, action)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("store answer/action: %v", err)
	}

	stored, err := repository.GetByStudentAndID(ctx, studentID, action.ID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read owned action: %v", err)
	}
	if stored.ID != action.ID || stored.StudentID != studentID || len(stored.LearningTargets) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected stored action: %+v", stored)
	}
	if _, err := repository.GetByStudentAndID(ctx, uuid.NewString(), action.ID); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatalf("foreign action error=%v, want not found", err)
	}

	useCase := studentuc.GetLearningActionContext{Actions: repository}
	handler := internalapi.NewHandler(nil, nil, nil, useCase)
	router := internalapi.NewRouter(handler, "internal-token")
	request := httptest.NewRequest(
		http.MethodGet,
		"/students/"+studentID+"/learning-actions/"+action.ID+"/context",
		nil,
	)
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "internal-token")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("context HTTP status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	var payload domain.LearningActionContext
	if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &payload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode context response: %v", err)
	}
	if payload.LearningActionID != action.ID || payload.Status != domain.LearningActionStatusOpen || len(payload.LearningTargets) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected context response: %+v", payload)
	}
}
